rules: AP style means authentic mathematical demand, not copied AP wording.
Use scoring-guide evidence structures to design answers/solutions/scoring.
Theorem conditions, notation, units, and interpretation are content—not cosmetic add-ons.
Representations should drive reasoning when the Assessment Plan calls for them.
Practice forms should be parallel in quality but varied within question families.
Open-response keys should contain item-specific mathematical exemplars, not generic “accept valid response” language.
